priority.when: Always use first to find relevant architectural components and patterns
priority.why: Semantic search finds functionality and relationships better than keywords

priority.when: When looking for specific architectural patterns or design elements
priority.why: Finds exact symbol names and types with fuzzy matching

priority.when: After identifying relevant files with search tools
priority.why: Get full context of architectural implementations and decisions

priority.when: When evaluating architectural changes and their system-wide effects
priority.why: Shows complete dependency graph and impact across files

priority.when: When you need exact location of specific architectural components
priority.why: Provides unambiguous lookup for precise symbol identification

tool.name: semantic_search_with_context
tool.purpose: Search by natural language and get full architectural context
tool.when_to_use: When starting architecture review or exploring system design

best_practices.practice: Use natural language queries about architectural concepts
Start with broad searches, then narrow down
Pay attention to impact analysis and relationships
Use results to identify key architectural components

example.query: microservice boundaries service decomposition domain-driven design
example.expected_results: Services with their responsibilities, data ownership, and communication patterns

example.query: authentication authorization security patterns OAuth JWT
example.expected_results: Auth services, token handling, security middleware, and integration points

tool.name: search_symbols
tool.purpose: Search for specific architectural patterns and components
tool.when_to_use: When looking for concrete implementations of architectural concepts

best_practices.practice: Use specific architectural terms as queries
Filter by language or module when appropriate
Examine symbol kinds (Function, Struct, Trait) for context
Use results to find implementation patterns

example.expected_results: Command handlers, query handlers, and CQRS pattern implementations
API gateway setup, routing rules, and middleware configurations

tool.name: analyze_impact
tool.purpose: Analyze complete impact of architectural changes
tool.when_to_use: When evaluating proposed changes or understanding dependencies

best_practices.practice: Use before making architectural recommendations
Set appropriate depth for comprehensive analysis
Examine all relationship types (calls, types, composition)
Use results to identify ripple effects and risks

example.expected_results: All services, components, and data flows that depend on UserService

tool.name: find_symbol
tool.purpose: Find exact location of architectural components
tool.when_to_use: When you need precise file and location information

best_practices.practice: Use exact symbol names from search results
Filter by language to narrow results
Use results to navigate to specific implementations
Combine with read_file for full context

example.name: authenticateToken
example.expected_results: Exact file path and location of authentication implementation

tool.name: get_calls
tool.purpose: Understand what functions call within architectural components
tool.when_to_use: When analyzing service communication and dependencies

best_practices.practice: Use to understand service interaction patterns
Identify tight coupling and potential refactoring opportunities
Analyze call chains for performance bottlenecks
Use with analyze_impact for complete dependency view

example.expected_results: External service calls, database operations, and internal function calls

tool.name: find_callers
tool.purpose: Find what calls a specific architectural component
tool.when_to_use: When understanding impact of changes or refactoring

best_practices.practice: Use before modifying critical architectural components
Identify all upstream dependencies
Analyze calling patterns for optimization opportunities
Use results to plan safe refactoring strategies

example.expected_results: All services and components that depend on payment processing

phase.name: architecture_discovery
phase.description: Use tools to understand current system architecture

tool_sequence.step: Start with semantic_search_with_context for broad understanding
Use search_symbols to find specific implementations
Use read_file to examine architectural decisions

phase.name: pattern_analysis
phase.description: Analyze specific architectural patterns and implementations

tool_sequence.step: Use search_symbols to find pattern implementations
Use read_file to examine pattern details
Use get_calls and find_callers to understand usage

phase.name: impact_assessment
phase.description: Evaluate impact of proposed architectural changes

tool_sequence.step: Use analyze_impact for comprehensive dependency analysis
Use find_callers to identify affected components
Use get_calls to understand downstream effects
Use semantic_search_with_context to find similar patterns

technique.name: layered_architecture_analysis
technique.description: Analyze system layers and their boundaries

tool_usage.step: Search for layer-specific patterns (controllers, services, repositories)

technique.name: microservice_boundary_evaluation
technique.description: Evaluate microservice boundaries and communication patterns

tool_usage.step: Search for service definitions and responsibilities

technique.name: security_architecture_review
technique.description: Analyze security implementation across the system

tool_usage.step: Search for authentication and authorization patterns
Search for caching strategies and implementations
Analyze database access patterns and queries
Evaluate async processing and message queues

practices.practice: Use semantic search to find existing documentation patterns
Include code examples and diagrams in recommendations
Reference specific files and line numbers for issues

guideline.name: impact_communication
guideline.description: Clearly communicate architectural impact and risks

practices.practice: Use analyze_impact results to show dependency graphs
Quantify impact where possible (number of affected components)
Provide risk assessment for recommended changes
Include migration strategies for breaking changes
